staged_checkpoint_defect.summary: parent_last_epoch was taken from the segment's own best history row while best.pt was staged; a segment that never beats its inherited best leaves best.pt untouched, so the two disagree
consequences: dicos-f-04 re-ran epochs 91-114 that dicos-f-03 had already trained
training.epochs became 136 from parent_last_epoch 111, so the restarted cosine annealed over 46 epochs instead of the declared 24

staged_checkpoint_defect.fix: checkpoint_epoch(best_path) is authoritative; staged_best_is_inherited() names the condition; supervisor journals segment_kept_inherited_best
